description: Transition priority tier registry for Canonical Game Schema v1.0.0. Lower numeric priority = higher precedence.
orderingRule: When multiple transitions match, sort by precedence.triggerOrder, then priority (ascending), then transition.id

validationRules.rule: If priorityTier is set, priority must equal defaultPriority OR fall within numericRange inclusive
DSL compiler must emit both priorityTier and priority
Missing priorityTier on hand-authored transition → GV-028 warning
Unknown priorityTier or priority outside all ranges → GV-027 error
priorityTier CUSTOM requires priority in 9000-9999 and validation review flag
Same state + trigger + priority + tier → warning
Ambiguous transition set without resolvable precedence → error

tiers.description: Enter a nested state machine via spawn effect (e.g. Hold & Win from base or free spins)
Enter a feature within the current machine via goto (e.g. Free Spins from base)
In-feature progression: retriggers, multi-step loops, internal step handlers
Exit feature to parent or base, or pop nested machine on completion
Discouraged escape hatch for exceptional graphs; requires manual validation review
